name: Frostbound
setting: icy temple courtyard, snow banks, frozen pines, blue glaciers, frost-covered rune pillars
palette: cold slate blue, ice cyan, muted snow white
text: Enemies move 12% slower. Frostbite: a hero that stays 15 seconds on one tile freezes over and attacks 25% slower until it moves. Shrine tiles never freeze.

name: Ashen Forge
setting: obsidian forge courtyard, lava channels only along borders, scorched dwarven pillars, ember-lit furnaces
text: Road heroes deal 15% more damage but receive 20% less healing. Eruptions: every 20 seconds two tiles glow, hero tiles first; 3 seconds later lava bursts there and heroes still standing on them lose 25% of their health. Move them in time.

name: Stormpeak
setting: mountaintop storm temple courtyard, broken lightning rods, rain-darkened stone, cloud banks outside edges
palette: slate violet, electric blue, subdued silver
text: Flying enemies move 20% slower. Platform heroes reach one step less; high-ground tiles shelter them. Lightning Rod: every 20 seconds a new tile draws the storm. A hero on it charges its ultimate 60% faster, but lightning strikes it for 8% of its health every 5 seconds.

name: Tidal Ruins
setting: sunken coastal temple courtyard above shallow sea, coral pillars, tide pools and turquoise surf strictly at borders
text: High tide (every other 20 seconds) floods a stretch of road: enemies wading through it move 35% slower and are Wet, heroes standing in it deal 20% less damage. At low tide enemies move 10% faster.

name: Mycelium Hollow
setting: underground mushroom sanctuary courtyard, giant bioluminescent fungi, twisting fungal roots and cave walls only at edges
palette: deep plum, muted turquoise, luminous mint
text: Heroes receive 25% more healing. Enemies gain 10% maximum health. Spore Bloom: every 12 seconds a mushroom grows on an empty road tile (up to 3). Enemies on it heal 3% of their health per second; a road hero standing on it tramples it.

name: Crystal Vault
setting: ancient crystal cavern temple courtyard, amethyst and aquamarine formations, fractured rune obelisks only at edges
text: Magical heroes deal 15% more damage. Physical heroes gain 10% attack speed. Prisms: every 20 seconds two platform tiles turn into prisms. A hero on one refracts each attack onto a second enemy for 50% damage.

name: Haunted Necropolis
setting: abandoned necropolis temple courtyard, mausoleums, skeletal trees, spectral mist and gravestones confined to edges
text: Nectar regrows 20% faster. Heroes receive 15% less healing. Restless Dead: fallen enemies may rise again as ghosts with 40% health and no gold. Enemies an Assassin or Support finishes stay down.

name: Autumn Sanctuary
setting: autumn temple courtyard in ancient woodland, red and orange maple canopy, fallen leaves, harvest stone statues at edges
palette: muted ochre, russet, moss, warm stone
text: Nectar regrows 15% faster. Road heroes charge their ultimates 15% faster. Windfall: every 15 seconds a golden fruit falls on an empty tile for 12 seconds. Move a hero onto it to collect 6 Nectar.

name: Celestial Observatory
setting: astral observatory temple courtyard floating among stars, antique gold armillary mechanisms and celestial columns at perimeter
palette: midnight blue, pale gold, subdued starlight
text: Heroes charge ultimates 20% faster for 20 seconds, then attack 10% faster for 20 seconds, and so on. Alignment: every 20 seconds the stars align over one row or column. Heroes standing in it deal 25% more damage.

name: Clockwork Citadel
setting: ancient clockwork temple courtyard, brass gears, steam vents, mechanical pillars and bronze conduits only at perimeter
palette: dark iron, tarnished brass, restrained turquoise
text: Heroes attack 15% faster. Enemies move 10% faster. Gear Jam: every 18 seconds two tiles are marked, hero tiles first; 3 seconds later the gears jam there and heroes still on them cannot attack for 5 seconds.
